effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has the [Dragonkin] or [Machine] trait, it can also attack your opponent's unsuspended Digimon.
